title: Florida House, District 94
what_it_does: Represents District 94 (Part of Palm Beach) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Megan Weinberger
candidates.occupation: Nonprofit executive director; founder of Rescue Life animal sanctuary; state representative since 2024
candidates.background: Meg Weinberger was born in Detroit, attended Palm Beach State College and spent a decade leading Rescue Life, an animal sanctuary she founded, while serving on boards including Stetson University, Big Dog Ranch and Place of Hope. She was elected to the Florida House in 2024 with about 55 percent of the vote and lives in the Caloosa area of Palm Beach Gardens.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

taxes.summary: Her site says she will cut taxes, reduce the size of government and cut red tape.
taxes.quote: Cut taxes, reduce the size of government, and cut red tape to unleash our economic potential.

sources.title: Meg for Florida - Meg Weinberger campaign site

property_tax.summary: Voted yes on HJR 1-F (June 2, 2026) and HJR 203 (Feb. 19, 2026); she told the Town-Crier she supports Amendment 3 but believes more needs to be done, and her site credits her with passing property tax initiatives.

candidates.name: Elizabeth Holmes
candidates.occupation: Public school teacher (English and Exceptional Student Education), Palm Beach County
candidates.background: Elizabeth Holmes grew up in Wellington, earned an English education degree from Florida Atlantic University and has taught in Palm Beach County public schools for about 15 years, first English and now students with special needs. The daughter of a teacher and a postal worker, she is a mother of four and lives in Palm Beach Country Estates.

candidates.name: Doug Barrow
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Doug Barrow is a no-party candidate from the Caloosa area of Palm Beach Gardens whose children attend public schools. He filed in May 2026, says local government should not be a partisan conversation, and did not respond to the Town-Crier's interview requests.
